CreCreationNotes:
This programme was crafted on board the Dunera passenger ship, as it made its way from Liverpool to Sydney, c. 1941. The show, entitled "The Man in the Bowler Hat" was produced by Peter Land and was presented by the Entertainment Committee in the first class lounge on November 1st 1941 at 8:15pm. 

The program includes two pages of printed text, each which impart information about the show's production. Max Lewinsky was the choreographer in charge, Ray Martin was responsible for musical arrangements, and Bernard Bell was the stage manager.
